node.statement: Theorem 4.1 (Approximate unitary t-design existence): For d a power of 2 and any t, there exists a distribution P over U(d) that is a (1/2)-approximate unitary t-design, where each unitary has a log(d)-qubit circuit with poly(log(d)*t) gates, constructible in poly(log(d)*t) classical time. Proof: Combines the explicit t-design construction of [OSP23] (Theorem 2.11) with the local-to-global circuit compilation of [HLT24] (Corollary 1.2), and the diamond-distance-to-design conversion of [BHH16] (Lemma 3) and [Low10] (Lemma 2.2.14).
